text:
maria: deploy-bot flagged a conflict: values override already queued for 2PM window, trying to push chart v2.3.1 with cpu tweak. can we coordinate?

deploy-bot: Automated check: release window conflict detected for namespace=payments, chart=payments-service v2.3.1, pending values-override id=val-8721. Action: PAUSE until manual ack.

devon: ah — I submitted the cpu limit change for a hotfix. didn't realize someone else queued overrides. can we serialise?

jamal: we're running a canary at 2:10 for v2.3.1, if we block this patch we lose the canary slot. current canary metrics look fine but the override touches DB pool size which is risky.

sasha: proposal: two options — 1) pin chart to v2.3.0 and apply values-override later, 2) apply override behind a feature flag and run a short canary. leaning to pin + rollback plan.

maria: ok — ops-oncall, can you approve a manual pin for the 2PM window while devon files a hotfix PR with the override behind flag? we need a way out if canary fails. :pray:

ops-oncall: I can approve the pin. Will create a manual release hold and add rollback playbook link. Doing now.

deploy-bot: Manual hold applied by ops-oncall. release_hold_id=hold-334. Notifying release-notes-bot.

devon: working on a PR now: short description and test matrix. I'll include helm diff and the exact --set commands. snippet:```helm upgrade payments-service ./charts/payments --version 2.3.0 --set resources.requests.cpu=250m --set pool.size=20``` Will also add an automatic revert job if canary error rate >1%.

jamal: sounds good. for rollback: recommend baked job that runs `helm rollback payments-service 1` and restores values from last-known-good configmap. add runbook note in release notes.

sasha: I'll draft the release notes section: "Pinned payments-service to 2.3.0 while hotfix is validated; hotfix will be merged and re-deployed behind feature flag. Canary at 2:10. Ops hold applied."

maria: timeline: ops hold in place until 3:00pm. devon aim to have PR + tests by 2:30pm. jamal will monitor canary and execute rollback if errors spike.

deploy-bot: Reminder: automatic expiry for hold-334 in 60 minutes unless extended.

ops-oncall: extended hold to 3:30pm to give time for PR reviews. logging action.

devon: PR created: github.com/redwood/payments/pull/418 — includes helm diff, test logs, and a small smoke test harness. tagging @sasha for release notes.

jamal: monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/payments-canary. will post updates in thread.

maria: thanks everyone. after canary we decide: if stable -> unpin and merge hotfix; if not -> rollback and open incident. :thumbsup:
